item.title: ‘Sam Almond’ becomes a meme after the OpenAI CEO’s comments on ChatGPT’s water usage
item.description: The tech billionaire weighted into the debate about generative AI’s impact on the environment, which is notably difficult to track. Thirty-eight thousand ChatGPT queries versus a single almond may sound like a strange sequel to the “100 men versus a gorilla” viral debate meme. Instead, it’s just Sam Altman’s response to public concerns over AI’s water usage....

item.title: What’s the beef? Rising meat prices at Walmart, Costco, Aldi, Publix, and more prompt Department of Justice probe
item.description: The DOJ just expanded its investigation into eight major grocery chains and big box retailers, asking ‘how beef prices got so high.’ The U.S. government is expanding its investigation into the rising price of beef to eight major grocery chains and big box retailers.
